_comment: Shared vectors for the mail-tool ACTION classifier (graph-forward card, spec G1-G7, Brainy 2958). Each case is a tool name plus a representative tool_input and the class every gate must give it, whatever the server name or version prefix: expected=send -> the main-agent approval gate is in scope (level logic runs), the copy gate audits the text, the sub-agent JS gate denies unconditionally; expected=draft -> the approval gate is NOT in scope, the copy gate audits, the JS gate ledger-checks the recipients; expected=nonsend -> all three pass the call untouched. today_spec=true marks the rows the spec says today's name patterns already recognise (the observed base verdicts are in golden-base.json, section g7_observed_base). extra=true rows are additions that are unambiguous under G1/G4 but are not in the spec list. get_send_as is an accepted false positive (any send token is fail-closed). Written by build_vectors.py; ASCII only. classifier_edges (added in N1b): name-only edge cases of the classifier, expected 'send', 'draft' or null, checked against both implementations (python mail_tool_action, JS mailToolAction). manage_email_ops (card 2f835ee4 r5): operation strings of the multiplexed manage_email tool and whether the shared normalisation (email_extract.manage_email_op_outbound / manageEmailOpOutbound in email-send-gate.mjs) takes them for an outbound operation; both twins must agree on every row. closed (card d8d3441e): optional per row, default = outbound; email_extract.manage_email_op_closed / manageEmailOpClosed say true for outbound OR unreadable operations (not a string, or empty after the normalisation), and every gate takes closed as a send.
